meta.title: Capy TV, the open-source IPTV player
meta.description: A free, open-source IPTV player for your TV, phone and computer. It plays the Xtream or M3U list you already have. It comes with no channels or content.

hero.body: A free, open-source IPTV player for your TV, phone and computer. It takes the Xtream or M3U list you already have and turns it into movies, series and live TV that follow you from screen to screen.
hero.note: Capy TV comes with no channels, lists or content.

handoff.title: Start on one screen, finish on another
handoff.body: With sync on, stop a movie on your phone and the TV offers to go on from the same minute. Your place follows every title from device to device, and Send to puts what you're watching on the screen you pick.
handoff.alt: Home on a TV offering to go on with an episode left on a phone, above the Continue watching row

profiles.title: A profile for each person
profiles.body: Everyone gets their own favorites, history, Continue watching and audio and subtitle languages. A PIN can lock a profile, adult content stays hidden unless a profile turns it on, and kids' profiles can have a daily time limit.
profiles.alt: Who's watching screen with four profiles over a wall of posters

sync.title: Your own cloud, encrypted end to end
sync.body: Lists, favorites, progress and profiles reach your other devices in a second or two. Everything is encrypted before it leaves the device and kept on a sync server you run with one Docker command. It's optional, and the server can't read what it stores.
sync.cipherLabel: The same three lines as unreadable encrypted text

more.title: Several providers, one catalog
more.body: A title they share shows once and plays from whichever is usually fastest at that hour.

more.title: A copy that won't start
more.body: Capy tries the next one by itself before ever saying a title is unavailable.

more.title: Change provider, keep your history
more.body: Favorites and progress move to the new list, matched by title.

more.title: Pause live TV
more.body: Pause and rewind a live channel, then jump back to live.

more.title: Four channels at once
more.body: Multiview shows up to four live channels, and you choose which one you hear.

more.title: Record from the guide
more.body: Schedule a programme and it records with nobody watching.

more.title: Your phone does the typing
more.body: Scan a code on the TV to add a list, sign in or use your phone as a remote, over your own network.

more.title: Chromecast, in beta
more.body: Cast from any platform, Fire TV and Windows included.

more.title: Search that forgives
more.body: Words in any order, cut short or with a typo, across the whole catalog and the guide.

more.title: New episodes of your series
more.body: Home shows which series you follow have something new, and the next episode to watch.

more.title: Surprise me
more.body: Pick a mood and get one well-rated title you haven't seen.

more.title: Picks for each profile
more.body: Optional recommendations with the AI service you choose, only from what your list has.

night.title: Can't agree on a movie?
night.body: Movie night puts six titles to a vote. Everyone scans the code on the TV and says yes or no from their phone. Capy counts the votes and shows the winner, ready to play.
night.alt: Movie night screen with a QR code, six posters and the votes for each

project.title: A home project, now open to anyone
project.body: Capy TV started as a player for one family, after the app they relied on stopped being updated. It's written from scratch, costs nothing, and has no ads or analytics.
project.built: Built with Flutter and libmpv. Licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.

items.q: Does it include channels or movies?
items.a: No. Capy TV is only a player. You need a list from a provider of your own, and it's up to you to have the right to watch what that list offers.

items.q: Where do I get a list?
items.a: From a provider you choose. This project doesn't sell, recommend or link to any.
Xtream Codes accounts and M3U playlists, with XMLTV guides.
